character.appearance: Hair tied back, ginger beard, bare feet.
character.trait: Ambition persists across lives. Your will and soul are so closely bound that memories of this life would eventually return even after ordinary reincarnation.

skills.name: Mana manipulation
skills.summary: Direct mana into a deliberate working.
skills.detail: Your reserves give you room to experiment. Your knowledge of physical principles gives you ways to recognise and test an effect. Practical control has yet to be demonstrated.

inventory.name: Pendant and chain
inventory.description: Round pendant on a fine chain.

story.title: Earth
story.text: You died in your sleep. The cause is unknown.

story.title: The threshold
story.text: People in a world losing its war prayed for a saviour. A presence recognised in your soul an affinity for that world and chose you.

story.title: The crossing
story.text: The presence carried your original body across and revived it. Your brain, memories and Earthly knowledge came with you. The first wilderness scene has yet to begin.
